lines.en: : ...and so that’s the story of how Ayane got kicked out of Taco Bell!
: Yeah...that sounds about right.
: Forgive me, but I’m a bit lost. I’m not seeing the connection between elephants and affordable (By commoner standards)
: That’s exactly it, Touka! Those two things have nothing to do with one another.
: It’s just Ayane being Ayane, I guess.
: The Amamiya family sure uses their wealth in a different way than my own.
: Why, I recall a time not too long ago when I was craving nourishment. My father had an entire restaurant airlifted all the way to me just to satisfy those needs.
: You mean like...some kind of helicopter DoorDash or something?
: Heavens, no. I mean the entire restaurant. And, come to think of it, that time was last night.
: Is that funny by your standards, Ami? I’m attempting to mimic lower middle class humor by telling mildly amusing stories that people from all walks of life can relate to.
: Wait...why just me? Karin counts as a commoner too, doesn’t she?
: I’m afraid I’ve only just met her, so I didn’t want to assume she had less money than she actually does and wind up offending her.
: That’s not really something that would offend anyone, Touka. I mean, the majority of the country is in the same financial bracket as Ami and me.
: That’s right. We have accepted our place in society as average Joes and Julies and must resort to dreaming about the amount of money you have since we’ll never actually have it.
: I’m very sad to hear this, but I’m still having trouble understanding how the elephant wound up inside of the restaurant.
: Haha! Classic Ayane.
: That girl's going to walk into the wrong fast food place one day.
: Just kidding. She already did that.
: I tried to make a joke but it sounded more like I wasn’t paying attention. I am.
: I’m sorry, everyone.
: Otoha, where did you get your swimsuit? I really like it.
: Uhh...Amazon? I don’t really remember.
: Are you just saying that because we’ve already name dropped Taco Bell and DoorDash and this is the product placement event?
: What? No. Of course not.
: Oh, look. Here comes Maya.
: Hey, guys.
: Princess Maya! What are you up to this fine morning?
: Just enjoying the crisp, refreshing taste of a Coca Cola.
: How about you?
: We’re trying to figure out which store Otoha got her swimsuit from.
: I’m not really participating in any way. I’m supposed to stay out of product placement because it won’t be good for my image if I make it in the future.
: That’s really depressing.
: But what’s not depressing is the taste of an ice cold Coca Cola after a long day of work or[school].
: Coca Cola.
: Anyway, bye.
: Yeah, so I’m pretty sure I just got it off Amazon.
: Neat!
: Hey...you went out with Rin after D&D last night, didn’t you?
: Hm? Yeah, right before we went back to our rooms. We didn’t really do anything, though. Why do you ask?
: Oh. I was just wondering how things went since...Nodoka told me you thought she might have been avoiding you.
: Oh! Yeah. I...think that’s over with now?
: Was just kinda confused since she’s never done anything like that before.
: I'm pretty sure it was just a weird morning. And...however long she was doing it before that for.
: It was probably several weird mornings.
: I don’t know. I’m glad everything is okay, though.
: You two made plans for...tonight, didn’t you?
: Uhh...I think so?...
: But she kind of just ran off as soon as I agreed so...can only imagine what that was about.
: Have I mentioned at all this morning how much I hate the two of you and want you to die?
: Yes. Several times on the way to the table. And when we passed that one palm tree that looked like a hockey stick. And then again when we sat down.
: I recall the last instance, but this is the first time our deaths have been associated with it.
: Do you really desire large breasts so badly that it drives you to despising those who possess them?
: Whaaaat? Meeeee? Noooooo. Meeeee?
: You...are really pretty though, Touka.
: Like...not just your breasts. But the...whole Touka...thing...
: Oh my.
: Karin...you aren’t flirting with me, are you? Because I’ve not yet trained myself on how to properly reject a woman- let alone one that’s also my senpai.
: Why do I even talk when everything I say comes out as...words?
: Don’t worry, Karin! You’ll get there soon enough!
: What I used to do to prepare myself for saying cute things to Sensei was saying them to stuffed animals first!
: Then, once I was able to do it with my eyes closed, I’d go say it to him.
: It never worked so this probably isn’t great advice, but I’m sure you get what I’m trying to say.
: My, how peculiar.
: I do believe there is a famous pop musician who just joined us at the table.
: Touka...I don’t know how else to say this, so I’m just going to be blunt.
: Your high class jokes don’t really work on us...normal people.
: You can’t just say “Oh look, there’s a thing here that isn’t actually there,” because that’s more like a...prank than a joke.
: And even then, it’s just...not all that funny.
: Oh my God. Niki Nakayama is right behind you.
: See? It’s just not funny at all. And thanks for the example, Karin.
: No...Ami, I do believe she is, in fact, right behind you.
: She’s looking right at you.
: Poor Chika...sleeping in on the day her favorite artist shows up to breakfast.
: Guys, I’m not going to fall for it.

: I might not look mature, but I can guarantee you that there’s no way I’m gullible enough to believe that the queen of everything, Niki Nakayama, my all time favorite non-Sensei human, is at our table.
: You think Niki would come to this beach? Are you insane?
: Sure, she might be Noriko’s older sister, but there’s no way Noriko would be able to convince her to come waste her time on us when she has so many better things to do.
: Yo. What are you doing here?
: Is this...
: Is this real?
: I think you better turn around...
: You too, Futaba? Come on. I’m not-
: *Ahem*
: Surprise! I brought a pop star!
: Noriko, you didn’t-
: AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH! YOU REALLY ARE HERE!
Ami jumps out of her seat at the picnic table and stands before who I guess is her role model.
Little does Ami know, her role model is actually a conniving and evil pink demon who thinks the world should bow before her because she knows how to dance or something.
Just kidding.
Niki isn’t that bad. She just calls me mean things a lot.
But so does Maya and I still talk to her.
And Yumi.
And Tsuneyo.
And Wakana and Osako.
Wait, why are so many girls mean to me?
Am I actually unpopular with women?
: Hi, Ami.
: You’ve gotten so tall.
: Well...comparatively. You weren’t even really human sized the last time I saw you.
: You...saw me and...I don’t remember it?
: You were just a little kid back then. I can’t even remember how old.
: She was also at the diner when you were there for the D&D thing.
: If I knew it was this big of a deal, I would have just introduced you back then.
: You knew Ami was at the diner and you didn’t introduce me?!
: You knew Niki was at the diner and you didn’t introduce me?!
: Jeez. There’s no need to be dramatic. I didn’t realize it was that big of a thing.
: You know I love Niki! She’s the only girl I’d share you with!
: You don’t have to worry about that. Your [uncle] and I broke up a really long time ago. Before you two...even...
: You know what? Let’s not even talk about that. Can I have a hug?
: You...you’re asking...me for a hug?...
: But...but you’re...an angel...and I’m just...
: An adorable [young_girl] who I’ve wanted to see again for a very long time.
: This can’t be real...
: Hug my friggin’ sister, Ami. She’s waited years for this moment!
: We should probably tell Niki that Ami very likely won’t ever let go. It’s hard enough for me to get her off and she doesn’t sing any of my songs while she’s in the bath.
: I was unaware you had songs, Sensei.
: Yeah, well, now I guess you’ll have to come to my next band practice.
: They’re kind of ruining the moment, aren’t they?
: I’m still...trying to figure out if...I’m going to wake up or not...
: So...that rumor was...actually true?
: Sensei...dated Niki?...
: The Niki?...
: I didn’t believe it at first either, but...yup.
: She still talks about him all the time, too.
: Granted, it’s in a pretty horrible way since all she does is complain...but they definitely dated.
: Great...
: Well...I guess my self-confidence was bound to vanish again soon enough.
: Dude, no. You’re great. Don’t go letting this drag you down just because Niki has depressingly poor taste in guys.
: Hey. I heard that.
: It must have been hard having to take care of your [uncle] for all those years, huh?
: I can’t believe...this is happening...
: You did a great job, Ami.
: Even if he’s a horrible human being who left me on my own until just recently.
: And then ditched me to come to the beach with my little sister.
: And never told me that we were literally right next to each other and that this reunion took much longer to happen than it had to.
: But besides all of that, you did great.
: You can cry as much as you want.
: *Sniff*
: Can you...move in with us?...
: Um...I don’t think that’s a very good idea.
: But if your asshole [uncle] wants to finally tell me where he’s been hiding out all these years, I’d be happy to come over and see you whenever I can!
: And let me clarify! I mean you, Ami! Not him!
: Ooooooooh...you’re in troooooouble...
: I’m pretty much always in trouble. It has become a staple of my everyday life.
: But that’s just how things work when everyone around you falls in love with you.
: Guess so.
: Those two are cute, though, huh?
: It’s almost like Niki would rather have Ami as a sister than me.
: Seems like she’s playing more of a mother role right now.
: She really did worry, you know. I wasn’t kidding about that.
: I did too, of course. But it’s not like I was really old enough to remember that much about Ami.
: I just always used to hear Nee-chan talking about you two...hoping that you two were able to be there for each other because you wouldn’t let us be there for you.
: That wasn’t fair, you know.
: I understand that Ami’s your family...but you had more family than that. You had us.
: We were little angels back then.
: And if you played your cards right and waited until I was developed and stuff, I probably could have talked Nee-chan into a threesome. Lord knows I was ready for it.
: Oh. I thought this was going to be a sentimental moment. Now I’m just turned on.
: Whoops~
: Really, though. I’m glad we could be here to see this.
: But aaaaaafterwards...if you’d want to go back to the inn-
: NORIKO! GET YOUR STUPID FUCKING HEAD OFF OF HIS STUPID FUCKING SHOULDER!
: What?! You’re interrupting my seduction!
: Did...Did Niki just curse?...
: Is she allowed to do that?
: Oh man. You guys have no idea...
Niki manages to break apart from Ami much easier than I thought she’d be able to before making her way over to Noriko and demanding that she help her with her shoot.
Being unable to refuse as her sister’s part time employee or...helper or whatever Noriko’s unofficial title is, she submits and vanishes shortly after.
The rest of the girls disperse, but Ami remains standing in the exact place where she and Niki separated.
I look down to see her clasping something in her hands and, to my surprise, it’s a business card.
However, I notice that it is distinctly different from the one she handed me when we first “reunited,” confirming that Niki actually is a demon and likes my [niece] more than me.
: Are you going to call her?
: ...Can I?
: You can do whatever you want. Just know that she’s really busy most of the time.
: Sorry, Sensei...but I’m gonna go wash my face...I think I cried a little too much.
: Hm? Oh, sure. I’ll just...see you later then, I guess.
Ami takes off as well, leaving me alone on the sand despite knowing a grand total of twenty-four girls on the beach right now.
I guess it’s a big beach, though. So I’m bound to run into-
: Sensei?
See what I mean?
